titles.native: センシティブ・ポルノグラフ

description:
Featuring two short stories, the first is about two manga-ka with a ten year age difference, Seiji Yamada and Sono Hanasaki and their intimate love life and problems. The second story is about the strange incident that happens to pet-sitter Ueno when he goes to take care of a pet rabbit named Aki, who he finds out is actually a human man.

(Source: Anime News Network)
